lines.text: Joseph, a Council member from Arimathea, went to Pilate and asked for the body of Jesus.
Joseph wrapped the body in a linen cloth and placed it in a tomb cut into the rock.
The women from Judea followed, saw the tomb, then prepared spices and rested on the Sabbath.
On the first day of the week, the women found the stone rolled away, and two men said Jesus has risen.
The women told the Eleven, who believed them, but Peter ran to the tomb and saw only linen cloths.
